description: This file implements a service for retrieving and aggregating Large Language Model (LLM) cost data by agent. It defines functions to resolve collection candidates, build MongoDB aggregation pipelines for different schema variations, perform in-database aggregation with fallbacks to in-process methods, and export these functionalities. The code includes detailed comments and specific logic to handle data normalization, currency parsing, and result sorting.

methods.name: resolveCollectionCandidates()
methods.description: Determines collection names from environment variables or defaults, prioritizing specific collection names for LLM cost events.

methods.name: buildFlatAgentCostPipeline()
methods.description: Constructs a MongoDB aggregation pipeline to process documents with flat schema fields for agent and cost, normalizing and summing costs.

methods.name: buildAgentsArrayPipeline()
methods.description: Creates an aggregation pipeline for documents where agents are in an 'Agents' array, aggregating costs per agent.

methods.name: aggregateAgentsInApp(documents = [])
methods.description: Performs in-process aggregation on an array of documents with 'Agents' arrays, summing costs and preserving display casing.

methods.name: getLlmCostByAgent()
methods.description: Main exported async function that attempts to retrieve aggregated LLM cost data by agent from the database with fallbacks to in-process aggregation if necessary.
